skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and master the framework, standards, and stages of the risk management process in insurance businesses; Master risk management tools.
Master techniques for identifying, analyzing, and evaluating risks in insurance business operations; Apply knowledge to assess risks in insurance business operations.
Apply knowledge of risk management in insurance to recommend risk management strategies for insurance businesses.
Develop skills in synthesis, analysis, and systematic thinking; Possess the ability to organize and manage resources to support specialized management activities in insurance business operations.
Demonstrate self-reliance when working independently, show personal responsibility and responsibility towards the group.
Express and defend personal views based on an objective and scientific approach to risk management activities in insurance businesses.
